protocol.purpose: Prospective confirmation on new public-record non-arithmetic tasks; FULL versus COMPACT with identical contract checks.
protocol.feedback: actionable/category-v1, at most 1000 characters; no scoring oracle feedback
protocol.quotaPolicy: Wait on the same credential; never change credentials in response to a quota error. Stop on persistent quota, authentication, network or provider failure and retain partial results.
protocol.billing: Use only user-authorized free-tier Groq credentials. Actual account billing cannot be verified by this runner.
protocol.latency: Descriptive only: provider client phases, coordinator work, dispatch waits, quota waits and session wall time remain separate. No speed claim from parallel throughput.
protocol.analysis: Report matched pairs and model/family strata. Repeats measure consistency, not independent task count. Describe per-task paired differences averaged over models/repeats and cluster bootstrap by six projects; uncertainty with six clusters is weak.
protocol.stopRule: Complete frozen schedule or stop after declared provider failure or request cap; never stop because an accuracy threshold was met.
protocol.novelty: Untouched by prior local model experiments, not guaranteed absent from model pretraining. New tasks are researcher-created adaptations of real public records, not organically collected user prompts.
protocol.review: Deterministic independent semantic oracle plus exhaustive valid alternatives and corruption controls; no independent human review. Synthetic corruption controls are not live inputs.
protocol.interpretation: Tests declared application relationships only. Does not establish a need for new JSON Schema vocabulary or prove general production safety. No ordinary-schema-only generation arm.
